english.title: Cause use of motor vehicle / trailer for an unsuitable purpose - non endorsable offence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

for the purpose of **(..SPECIFY PURPOSE..), that being a purpose for which it was so unsuitable as to cause or be likely to cause danger or nuisance to any person in or on it or on a road
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100(3) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause use on a road of a motor vehicle/trailer
for a purpose for which it was so unsuitable
as to caused/likely to cause
danger/nuisance

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) OFFICERS SHOULD BE AWARE that this is a non-endorsable offence - a comparable endorsable offence exists under section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 which should be used wherever possible.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Any additional aggravating feature may be detailed in the Statement of Facts.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
